 <div dmwrapped="true" id="dmFirstContainer" class="dmBody u_dmStyle_template_primal-explorer dm-home-page" themewaschanged="true"> <div id="allWrapper" class="allWrapper" data-auto="all-wrapper"> <div id="dm_content" class="dmContent" role="main"> <div dm:templateorder="170" class="dmHomeRespTmpl mainBorder dmRespRowsWrapper dmFullRowRespTmpl" id="1716942098"> <div class="u_1323425029 dmRespRow" style="text-align: center;" id="1323425029" data-anim-desktop="none"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1542234389"> <div class="dmRespCol small-12 u_1854405617 medium-12 large-12" id="1854405617"> <div data-element-type="spacer" class="u_1940124690 dmSpacer" id="1940124690"></div>

 <div class="u_1856952287 dmRespRow" id="1856952287" data-anim-extended="eyJkZXNrdG9wIjp7InRyaWdnZXIiOiJ2aWV3cG9ydCIsImFuaW1hdGlvbiI6Inpvb21JbiIsInJldmVyc2UiOmZhbHNlLCJpbnRlbnNpdHkiOjEsInZpZXdwb3J0VGhyZXNob2xkcyI6eyJ0b3AiOiI2NiUiLCJib3R0b20iOiIwJSJ9LCJkZWxheSI6MCwiZHVyYXRpb24iOjF9fQ=="> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1006506730"> <div class="u_1213308643 dmRespCol small-12 medium-6 large-6" id="1213308643"> <div class="u_1158393188 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1158393188" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s;"> <h3><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></h3> 
 <h3 class="m-size-14 size-18"><strong style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 700; display: initial;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-14">Unplug. Unwind. Ride the Edge of Paradise.</strong></h3> 
<p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p> <h4><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></h4> 
</div> 
 <div class="imageWidget align-center u_1532411873" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1532411873"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/50bb3a28/dms3rep/multi/opt/pexels-photo-15898685-1920w.jpeg" alt="" id="1140870603" class="" width="1920" height="2560" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/50bb3a28/dms3rep/multi/pexels-photo-15898685.jpeg" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
 <div class="u_1838472928 imageWidget align-center" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1838472928"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/50bb3a28/dms3rep/multi/opt/rosalia_lamu-1920w.jpg" alt="" id="1903884409" class="" width="750" height="938" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/50bb3a28/dms3rep/multi/rosalia_lamu.jpg" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
 <div class="imageWidget align-center u_1542108542" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1542108542"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/50bb3a28/dms3rep/multi/opt/L1135837-1920w.JPG" alt="" id="1033153230" class="" width="1920" height="1440" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/50bb3a28/dms3rep/multi/L1135837.JPG" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
</div> 
 <div class="u_1456959295 dmRespCol small-12 medium-6 large-6" id="1456959295"> <div class="u_1820156328 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1820156328" style="transition: none 0s ease 0s; text-align: left; display: block;"> <h1><span style="display: initial; font-style: normal;" class="m-font-size-18" m-font-size-set="true"><br/></span></h1> 
 <h1 class="size-30 m-size-18"><strong style="display: initial; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-style: normal;" class="font-size-30 m-font-size-18" m-font-size-set="true">KENYA PRIMAL EXPLORER:</strong></h1> 
 <h1 class="size-30 m-size-18"><strong style="display: initial; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-style: normal;" class="font-size-30 m-font-size-18" m-font-size-set="true">THE LAMU ARCHIPELAGO</strong></h1> 
 <h4><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></h4> 
</div> 
 <div class="u_1236565033 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1236565033" style="transition: none 0s ease 0s; text-align: left; display: block;"> <h1 class="size-18 m-size-16"><span style="color:rgb(255, 255, 255);display:initial;font-family:inherit;" class="font-size-18 m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">Where Luxury Meets Uncharted Wind &amp; Swahili Soul</span></h1> 
 <h1><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true"><br/></span></h1> 
 <h3 class="m-size-16"><span class="m-font-size-16" style="text-transform:uppercase;color:rgb(255, 255, 255);display:initial;font-family:inherit;font-style:normal;"><span style="text-transform:uppercase;color:rgb(255, 255, 255);display:initial;font-family:inherit;font-style:normal;" m-font-size-set="true" class="m-font-size-16">Step into a world where ancient coastal history meets world-class, untouched kiteboarding. The</span> 
</span><strong style="text-transform:uppercase;color:rgb(255, 255, 255);display:initial;font-family:inherit;font-style:normal;" m-font-size-set="true" class="m-font-size-16">Primal Explorer</strong><span class="m-font-size-16" style="text-transform:uppercase;color:rgb(255, 255, 255);display:initial;font-family:inherit;font-style:normal;"> <span style="text-transform:uppercase;color:rgb(255, 255, 255);display:initial;font-family:inherit;font-style:normal;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">journey takes you to the legendary Lamu Archipelago</span></span></h3> 
 <h3 class="m-size-16"><span style="text-transform:uppercase;color:rgb(255, 255, 255);display:initial;font-family:inherit;font-style:normal;" m-font-size-set="true" class="m-font-size-16">&mdash;a UNESCO-protected paradise of endless white sandbanks, quiet turquoise channels, and steady, trade-wind bliss.</span></h3> 
<p class="m-size-16"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">Designed for riders who crave equal parts adrenaline and refined luxury, this is more than just a kite trip; it&rsquo;s an immersive coastal retreat. Spend your days gliding across flat-water lagunas and dynamic downwind routes, and your evenings relaxing with tailored wellness sessions, curated local dining, and the timeless charm of dhow-sailed sunsets.</span></p><p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true"><br/></span></p> <h3 class="m-size-16"><strong style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">Why Lamu with Primal Explorer?</strong></h3> 
 <ul class="defaultList bullet"><li style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);" class="m-size-16"><strong style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">Untouched Wind &amp; Water:</strong><span class="m-font-size-16" style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;"> <span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">Ride vast, uncrowded flat-water spots and rolling coastal swells away from the commercial noise.</span></span></li><li style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);" class="m-size-16"><strong style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">Seamless Luxury &amp; Comfort:</strong><span class="m-font-size-16" style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;"> <span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">A fully guided, premium experience featuring high-end accommodations, private transfers, and top-tier support.</span></span></li><li style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);" class="m-size-16"><strong style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">Holistic Progression &amp; Recovery:</strong><span class="m-font-size-16" style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;"> <span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">Complement your sessions with targeted kite coaching, video analysis, daily yoga, breathwork, and massage therapy.</span></span></li><li style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);" class="m-size-16"><strong style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">Rich Cultural Immersion:</strong><span class="m-font-size-16" style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;"> <span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">Explore the historic streets, Swahili architecture, and timeless rhythm of Lamu Island.</span></span></li><li style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);" class="m-size-16"><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">EVERY DAY DIFFERENT KITEBOARDING SPOTS WITH SAILINGBOATS, BOAT TAXI, ALWAYS WITH SUPPORT AND GUIDING</span></li></ul> 
 <blockquote><strong style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">Ready to experience the ultimate kite safari?</strong></blockquote> 
 <blockquote><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: initial;" class="m-font-size-16" m-font-size-set="true">Spaces for our exclusive Lamu expedition are strictly limited to ensure an intimate, bespoke experience.</span></blockquote> 
 <h2 style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></h2> 
</div>

</span><strong style="text-decoration: underline; display: initial;">PRICING &amp; PACKAGES</strong></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p><strong style="display: initial;">PRIMAL EXPLORER &mdash; LAMU ARCHIPELAGO &amp; COASTAL SAFARI</strong></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p><span style="display: initial;">Join us for an unforgettable 8-night coastal journey through Kenya&rsquo;s breathtaking Lamu Archipelago and the vibrant coast of Nyali. From private luxury villa living on Manda Beach to total eco-luxury seclusion on the sand dunes of Kipungani, this all-inclusive itinerary combines high-end comfort, authentic dhow sailing, pristine ocean downwinders, and seamless travel.</span></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p><strong style="display: initial; text-decoration: underline;">What&rsquo;s Included</strong></p><p><strong style="display: initial;">3 Nights at PRIVATE VILLA (Manda Island):</strong><span style="display: initial;" single-space="true"> <span style="display: initial;"></span> 
</span></p><p><span style="display: initial;">Whole-house private villa stay on Manda Beach with private pool, full house staff, and dedicated private boat captain.</span></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p><strong style="display: initial;">3 Nights at LUXURY Eco Lodge (Kipungani):</strong><span style="display: initial;" single-space="true"> <span style="display: initial;"></span> 
</span></p><p><span style="display: initial;">Secluded beachfront eco-lodge stay with full board (all meals included).</span></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p><strong style="display: initial;">2 Nights in Nyali:</strong><span style="display: initial;"> <span style="display: initial;">Premium coastal accommodation to round out your expedition.</span></span></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p><strong style="display: initial;">Excursions &amp; Activities:</strong><span style="display: initial;"> <span style="display: initial;">Private dhow trip to Manda Toto, downwinders, and coastal AND ISLAND exploration.</span></span></p><p><strong style="display: initial;">Transfers &amp; Flights:</strong><span style="display: initial;"> <span style="display: initial;">all private boat transfers across the archipelago included.</span></span></p><p><strong style="display: initial;">Meals &amp; Extras:</strong><span style="display: initial;"> <span style="display: initial;">Daily breakfasts, LUNCH AND DINNER, EXCEPT FOR THE RESTAURANTS</span></span></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p><strong style="text-decoration: underline; display: initial;">Package Pricing (Per Person)</strong></p><p><span style="display: initial;">Pricing is tiered based on group size, offering maximum value when sharing private villas and boat charters:</span></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><span style="display: initial;">Group Size Price Per Person</span> 
</span></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p><p><strong style="text-decoration: underline; display: initial;">6 Guests</strong><span style="display: initial;" single-space="true"> <span style="display: initial;"></span> 
</span><strong style="display: initial;">&euro;2,400</strong><span style="display: initial;"> <span style="display: initial;">Maximum exclusivity, private villa feel, small-group vibe.</span></span></p><p><span style="display: initial;">BUDGET &euro;1400</span></p><p><strong style="text-decoration: underline; display: initial;">8 Guests</strong><span style="display: initial;" single-space="true"> <span style="display: initial;"></span> 
</span><strong style="display: initial;">&euro;2,300</strong><span style="display: initial;"> <span style="display: initial;">Great balance of privacy, spaciousness, and group value.</span></span></p><p><span style="display: initial;">BUDGET &euro;1300</span></p><p><strong style="text-decoration: underline; display: initial;">10 Guests</strong><span style="display: initial;" single-space="true"> <span style="display: initial;"></span>
